title: Introduction to GitHub Copilot in VSCode for AL Development
summary: GitHub Copilot in VSCode offers multiple AI-powered modes - Inline Suggestions, Chat, Ask, Edit, Agent, and Plan - to assist AL developers with code generation, refactoring, and understanding existing code. This guide explains how to set up Copilot and when to use each mode for different development tasks.
key_points: Copilot provides six distinct modes tailored to different AL development workflows, from quick autocomplete to workspace-wide refactoring
Chat mode allows developers to generate full AL objects, explain code, troubleshoot errors, and propose refactors through conversation
Agent mode performs multi-step changes across multiple files, such as applying ApplicationArea properties or adding telemetry hooks
Plan mode previews changes before applying them, which is important for AL projects with dependencies and object IDs
Ask mode provides lightweight code explanations by selecting and highlighting code snippets

quotes.text: GitHub Copilot has quietly become one of the most helpful tools for anyone working with Business Central.

quotes.text: Agent is where Copilot begins to feel like a collaborator rather than a suggestion engine.
